com.vector.cfg.automation.api.project

Interface ICreateProjectApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @NotThreadSafe
public interface ICreateProjectApi
    ICreateProjectApi provides means for parameterizing the creation of a new project.
    The ICreateProjectApi contains the methods to parameterize the creation of a new project.

      • setProjectFolder

        @PublishedMethod
void setProjectFolder(@Nonnull
                                        java.lang.Object projectFolder)
        Sets the folder in which to create the new project.
        Project Folder
        Specify the folder in which to create the new project in with setProjectFolder(Object). The value given here is converted to Path using the converter ScriptConverters.TO_SCRIPT_PATH .

        The following constraints apply:

        • Constraints.IS_CREATABLE_FOLDER

        Parameters:
        projectFolder - the folder in which to create the new project

      • setProjectName

        @PublishedMethod
void setProjectName(@Nonnull
                                      java.lang.String projectName)
        Sets the name for the newly created project.
        Project Name
        Specify the name newly created project with setProjectName(String). The name given here is postfixed with ".dpa" for the new project's .dpa file.

        The following constraints apply:

        • Constraints.IS_VALID_PROJECT_NAME

        Parameters:
        projectName - the name of the new project
